owner_intent: Mechanicus must separate build proof from source cleanliness, UI proof and runtime truth.
No task may claim build readiness without a build lane receipt.
Strict build lane must detect build targets and run only known safe build/check commands.
Build lane foundation must not install dependencies, mutate package versions or repair source automatically.
core_laws: Build proof is not code cleanliness.
Code cleanliness is not runtime proof.
Runtime proof is not semantic truth.
Detected build target must have an explicit command result or explicit debt reason.
npm build requires node/npm and existing dependencies.
cargo check requires rustc/cargo and a Cargo manifest.
No dependency installation without Owner command.
